name: measure-host-load
reason: Name an existing Windows load/core observation without labeling CPU utilization a Unix load average.
anchor: Check the load average with `uptime` and the core count with `nproc`.
replace: Check machine load and logical core count before starting. On Linux use `uptime` and `nproc`. On Windows PowerShell use `(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Measure-Object -Property NumberOfLogicalProcessors -Sum).Sum` for cores and `Get-CimInstance Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_Processor -Filter "Name='_Total'" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty PercentProcessorTime` for system CPU utilization (not load average); use Task Manager to identify competing processes.
